title: How to Edit / Update Subscriptions for Members with Recurring Subscriptions
text:
## How to Edit / Update Subscriptions for Members with Recurring Subscriptions
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000069505
Currently, subscriptions must be edited individually — including changes to the next billing date, amount, or billing cycle. Bulk updates for subscriptions are not currently available.
To modify an existing subscription, follow the steps below:
1. Go to Members » Search Members
2. Find the member
3. Click on Actions » Payment History
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092393739/original/VkT-RUCbWtKnjK2UvArFUZsQj5WKdX8Rhg.png?1620611270 | alt: ]
4. Click the "Subscriptions" tab:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092393743/original/J2230ExBnuuYLTnYzrLyAgNAxLX42A6KSA.png?1620611304 | alt: ]
5. Then find the subscription that needs to be modified and click Actions »
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092393747/original/v7MN4d2hD0c5kWYuEI-gR1J5mEV_7KNFBA.png?1620611341 | alt: ]
6. In this section, 4 fields can be modified:
Payment Amount
Billing Cycle
Next Payment Due Date
Deletion of past-due/upcoming invoices
Internal Subscription Notes can also be added at the bottom of the page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136719323/original/8x68AVRF__UTV8H0rlA_UUNOEsbZNGQkQQ.png?1704381385 | alt: ]
7. After making the changes, click "Continue & Save Changes"
8. The changes will be reflected here:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092393776/original/x4iDUBm1JRBL5v0GdIScnAI17zf8l1N3Jg.png?1620611455 | alt: ]

## Additional Subscription Information
Create a new order (subscription): How To Manually Bill A Member / Create A Subscription For A Member
Cancel orders: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders
Refund a member: How Refunds Work

## Subscription Expiration Date
Recurring subscriptions do not have an expiration date. A recurring subscription ends when the paid membership plan is cancelled by the member or the admin.
